unavailable.why: A general-season window is where a resident tag is valid. It is not a draw result, so it has no draw history.

unavailable.scope: nonresident deer and elk tag draw, 2024 and 2025
unavailable.why: The 2026 nonresident draw PDF is the only file of that report on IDFG and in the Internet Archive capture of that URL. 2024 and 2025 were not published at a URL that could be retrieved.

match: Species, controlled-hunt number, drawing (first or second) and area code must all match the 2026 hunt. A different area code is not history for that hunt.

sources.note: Hunt Planner drawing-odds API, first choice, resident and nonresident counts. Band is drawn divided by applied, with 1 only when every applicant was drawn.
